points: PalletPoseNode::on_pair calls estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 once, on the single DetectionCandidate from select_detection (default highest_confidence). Other pallet candidates are dropped before stage 2, so they do not multiply the chamfer cost and are not written to diagnostics.

The stage-2 hot path is two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 in coarse_chamfer_search_v2: an OpenMP-parallel brute-force grid. Default free coarse is 21 yaw steps (±10 deg at 1 deg) times 31 by 31 translations (±0.15 m at 0.01 m) = 20181 cost evaluations; free fine is 13 by 25 by 25 (±1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, ±0.012 m at 0.001 m) = 8125. Rotation is cached per theta per thread; every translation still pays a full cost.

When free chamfer cost is above about 0.0062 m, lambda_eff = prior_lambda * (1 - confidence) exceeds lambda_floor 0.05 (prior_lambda 3, reliable band 0.006–0.020 m), and estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 runs a second two-stage search, two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior. Prior coarse is 21 by 21 by 21 (±0.10 m at 0.01 m, same ±10 deg) = 9261, and prior fine repeats 8125. The common case is about 45700 grid evaluations per frame, plus one init cost per search, two choose_pi_ambiguous_pose costs, one anchor chamfer_cost_v2, and one post-search data cost.

Each grid evaluation in chamfer_cost_from_rotated deep-copies the rotated N×2 prototype into tls.translated, adds (tx, ty), bilinear-samples the float distance image, then trimmed_mean_from_distances assign-copies all N distances into a std::vector and std::sorts them even though trim_fraction 0.10 only sums the lowest ceil(0.9*N) values. Per candidate that is O(N log N) plus two N-length copies. Default contour_spacing_m 0.03 on the 1.20×0.14 m outer rectangle plus two 0.47×0.10 m pockets builds about 182 contour points (cached after the first call in cached_prototype).

Bilinear sampling reads Eigen column-major MatrixXd entries points(i,0) and points(i,1), which are N doubles apart, so the inner loop is strided. rotate_proto_into also materializes a temporary proto * R.transpose() on each theta change.

Before the search, rasterize_points_to_mask uses resolution_m 0.005 and padding_m 0.80, so a 1.2 m by 0.14 m inlier span becomes about 561×349 pixels rather than the face extent alone. close_mask clones that mask, runs a morphological close, then connectedComponentsWithStats (full-frame int labels) and a second output mat. compute_distance_transform_v2 builds another uint8 image and calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE, then convertTo a CV_32FC1 distance image. OpenCV imgproc on that padded raster is the large non-search dependency inside stage 2; the prototype cache does not reuse the distance image across frames.

sample_face_points scans every depth pixel, O(Hd*Wd), and for each finite in-range pixel does a K_inv ray, an SE3 into RGB, a pinhole project, and a mask test. Accepted points are pushed into per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> buckets (together reserved to Hd*Wd/4) and then copied again, one row at a time, into an N×3 Eigen::MatrixXd. build_bbox_mask first allocates and zeroes a full RGB-sized CV_8UC1 and erodes the whole image (erode_px 2), even though only the bbox rectangle is set.

ransac_plane_fit runs up to ransac_iters 100 (early stop only at inlier ratio 0.85). Every iteration allocates a residual ArrayXd and a bool mask over all face points; the winning mask is copied, inliers are copied row-by-row into a new MatrixXd, and svd_plane_refit runs Eigen::JacobiSVD. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 then builds plane_inlier_mask and copies those inliers a second time into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates both a relative N×3 matrix and an N×2 result; estimate_pca_long_axis allocates another centred copy of the 2D inliers. Those passes are linear in the face-point count and sit under the chamfer grid.

depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth frame into a new CV_32FC1 before stage 2. On the detector side, image_to_rgb copies the ROS buffer via bytes(msg.data), then ascontiguousarray (and a channel reverse for bgr8). preprocess does cv2.resize to 640×640, an astype float32, a CHW transpose, and another ascontiguousarray. TensorRTBackend.infer astype-copies both inputs, copyto into pagelocked host memory, memcpy HtoD, and .copy() of labels, boxes, and scores after DtoH. tensorrt plus pycuda dominate stage 1 when backend is tensorrt; the node default is mock, which does not.

geometry_core links Eigen3 dynamic matrices, OpenCV core and imgproc, and OpenMP (the chamfer flat loop and the depth scan), compiled -O3. yaml-cpp loads the camera model only in the node constructor, not per frame. message_filters ApproximateTime (queue 10, slop 0.1 s) only gates the pair; it is not the arithmetic hot path.
